text:
maria chen: heads up — spotted a weird mid-tail jump on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate in eu-west. p50/p95 look fine, p99 jumps ~400ms at 14:12 UTC. anyone see related alerts?
samir patel: which dashboard/time range? link?
maria chen: https://console.internal/redwood/dashboards/latency?svc=generate&range=15m — spike at 14:12-14:15. routing shows small bump to fallback pool.
jia wong: can you paste the rollup breakdown? curious if sample origin switched (gateway vs dedicated).
maria chen: rollup snippet: ```route=eu-west; client=tiny-client; p50=60ms; p95=120ms; p99=520ms; sample_count=180```
samir patel: sample_count low for p99 stability. but 520ms is suspiciously aligned with quota-fallback latency we've seen before. was there a quota change?
ops-bot: quota-config-service deployed commit 3721 to prod @ 13:58 UTC — changed region fallback ordering for quota exhaustion.
tomas lind: that deploy changed fallback order to prefer shared-gpu when dedicated exhausted. shared-gpu has higher cold-start KV overhead, so tail inflation is expected.
jia wong: ah — so requests hitting shared-gpu will add ~300–400ms occasionally. dashboard p99 will jump if fraction of traffic hits that pool.
maria chen: can we show sample origin on the percentile rollup? currently the UI only shows endpoint and region, not pool. makes debugging confusing. :thinking:
samir patel: +1. also would help to overlay quota boundaries (e.g., commit windows) on the timeline so we can correlate config changes without hopping to deploy logs.
tomas lind: easy UX proposal: add two toggles — "show sample origin" (gateway|dedicated|shared) and "annotate config changes" (deploys/quotas). low-risk, could be a console flag.
jia wong: implementation note: ensure sample origin is emitted at request time (we already tag telemetry with `pool_id` but it's currently stripped during rollup). just need to keep one tag through aggregation.
maria chen: for immediate triage, can we run a query to split p99 by pool_id for that 14:12 window?
samir patel: ran quick query: ```p99 by pool_id where svc=generate and ts in (7112232700..7112233500) -> pool: dedicated p99=110ms (160 samples), shared-gpu p99=520ms (20 samples)```
maria chen: that confirms it. small % hitting shared gives outsized p99 impact. suggests we should either adjust fallback policy or highlight this in console.
tomas lind: long-term: adjust routing policy to prefer warm shared nodes or ramp pool sizing. short-term: revert fallback order in EU for customers with strict tail SLOs? ops-team input needed.
jia wong: I'll open an issue for console changes (show sample origin + config annotations) and add a small design doc. linking to this thread.
maria chen: thanks — created issue #453: "console: surface sample origin and quota/deploy annotations for percentile debugging". assigning to devex + eng-platform. :thumbsup:
samir patel: for the immediate customer impact, I'll create a temporary routing override to send critical tenants back to dedicated while we sort sizing.
tomas lind: please ping ops if you flip it; want to watch quota math.
ops-bot: ticket #453 created by jia wong — console sample-origin proposal.
maria chen: great — resolving this thread, will follow up after the override and monitor p99. :eyes:
